title: October Prime Day Audio Deals Under $100: Save Up to 60% on Bose, Beats by Dre, Samsung & Other Top Brands
summary: During the two-day shopping event, Amazon has deep discounts on headphones, earbuds, speakers, turntables & other gear, sitewide.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Before the holiday shopping season, Prime Big Deal Days (AKA October Prime Day) starts Tuesday (Oct. 6) and goes until Wednesday (Oct. 7) on Amazon. During the two-day shopping event, the retail giant marks down nearly every category — including sound gear and home audio. Now is the best time to upgrade your home audio setup, or just grab a new pair of noise-canceling headphones for your daily commute for cheap.

Shop Prime Big Deal Days on Amazon

With savings up to 60% off list prices, ShopBillboard rounded up the best deals on all sorts of tech and home audio gear for Prime Big Deal Days . There are deep discounts on top brands, like Apple, Bose, Samsung, Beats by Dre, Razer and others. Best of all? All deals found are $100 or less, at the time of publishing.

But act fast and shop now, these deals are only active for a limited time and expire by Wednesday (Oct. 7) on Amazon.

PRIME BIG DEAL DAYS

JLab JBuds Sport ANC 4 True Wireless Bluetooth Earbuds

$39.00 $69.99 44% off

Buy Now On Amazon

On sale for $39 (was $69.99) on Amazon, the JLab JBuds Sport ANC 4 True Wireless Bluetooth Earbuds features more than 14 hours of wireless playback per charge.

Beats Solo 4 Headphones

$99.95 $199.95 50% off

The Beats by Dre Solo 4 Headphones come summer-ready in cloud pink, while they’re 50% off for Prime Big Deal Days.

Skullcandy Crusher Evo Headphones

$89.99 $209.99 57% off

Marked down to nearly 60% on Prime Big Deal Days, the Skullcandy Crusher Evo Headphones feature 40 hours of playback, active noise-canceling features, rich and clear audio quality with deep bass and on-ear music controls.

JLab JBuds Lux ANC Headphones

$41.99 $99.99 58% off

Available in navy, the JLab JBuds Lux ANC Headphones have Dolby Atmos compatibility for premium audio quality at a low price, especially since they’re on sale for nearly 60% off their list price.

Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 FE Earbuds

$99.99 $149.99 33% off

Priced at $99.99 (was $149.99) on Amazon, the Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 FE Earbuds rival Apple AirPods with high-quality audio, comfortable fit and feel, strong noise-canceling features and long battery life of up to 8.5 hours per charge.

Beats Studio Buds+

true wireless noise canceling earbuds

$89.95 $169.95 47% off

In Black & Gold

On sale for nearly 50% off and their all-time lowest price ever, the Beats Studio Buds+ deliver rich and immersive audio with top-tier noise-cancellation features and up to 36 hours of battery life per charge. These wireless earbuds are ideal for those with active and stylish lifestyles.

Bose SoundLink Flex Bluetooth Speaker

$99.00 $159.00 38% off

The Bose SoundLink Flex Bluetooth Speaker comes in sunset peach and is on sale for $99, or $60 off, a 38% savings. It’s waterproof, which is ideal for lounging around the swimming pool, comes with high-quality audio, which Bose is known for, and features up to 12 hours of battery life per charge.

Victrola Eastwood II Record Player

For just $99.99 (was $149.99) on Amazon, the Victrola Eastwood II Record Player is a fantastic turntable for those new to listening to vinyl, thanks to its simple controls, ease of use and sturdy build quality.

Razer BlackShark V2 Pro Wireless Xbox Gaming Headset

$69.99 $129.99 46% off

On sale for nearly 50% off, the Razer BlackShark V2 Pro Wireless Gaming Headset is a great option that’s compatible with most consoles including Xbox, PS5 and Switch along with PC and Mobile.

Luna Wireless Controller

$39.99 $69.99 43% off

The official wireless gaming controller for Amazon’s cloud gaming platform, Luna, is on sale for nearly 45% off its list price — its all-time lowest price ever.

Logitech G432 Wired Gaming Headset

$39.99 $79.99 50% off

On sale for $39.99 (was $79.99) on Amazon, the Logitech G432 Wired Gaming Headset is fantastic for immersive and detailed gaming audio, especially since it’s under $40.

Logitech G413 TKL SE Gaming Keyboard

$52.23 $79.99 35% off

Start building your wallet-friendly gaming PC with the Logitech G413 TKL SE Gaming Keyboard , which is on sale for 35% off its list price on Amazon. It’s wallet-friendly, clicky and precise, which are ideal for budget gaming.

Amazon Echo Spot

$54.99 $79.99 31% off

A sleek smart alarm clock with Alexa and big vibrant sound with clear vocals and deep bass. Just ask Alexa to play your favorite music, podcasts, and audiobooks in seconds.

Philips Hue Smart Light Starter Kit

$72.99 $142.99 49% off

Set the ultimate mood lighting in your home with dynamic light effects and millions of color options at your fingertips.

And because these deals are during Prime Big Deal Days, you’ll need to be an Amazon Prime member to activate the savings.
